'''Jumara 28 (February 15)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Perrin]] meets with [[Masema Dagar]] and convinces the Prophet to accompany him to [[Cairhien]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Faile]], [[Morgase|Maighdin]], and [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin|Alliandre]] are captured by the [[Shaido]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Nynaeve]] sends eighteen members of the [[Kin]] into [[Seanchan]]-occupied lands to find any remaining Kin refugees and bring them back.
